title: Get ready for a workout
instruction: Watch Lena prepare for and finish a workout. Describe her choices, then compare one habit with your own

video.title: Productive days in my life — LenaLifts

items.prompt: What change is Lena making to her usual morning drink?
items.hint: Compare her usual drink with the drink she has in this vlog
items.answer: She is taking a break from her usual coffee and starts this morning with an iced matcha

items.prompt: What does she prepare, and which workout does she plan?
items.hint: Listen to the kind of workout and the bag she mentions
items.answer: She plans a leg and glute workout and prepares her gym bag before going

items.prompt: What does she plan to do just after the workout?
items.hint: Listen to her next action when she finishes
items.answer: She plans to take a shower after the workout

items.prompt: Which habit would you keep or change? Compare your routine, then ask your teacher
items.hint: Use I usually… and once/twice/three times a week
items.answer: Example: I usually exercise in the afternoon three times a week. I pack my bag the night before because mornings are busy. When do you usually exercise?
